title: Tronian Nutron 510 Button Activated Battery V2
description:
Tronian Nutron is a 320mAh 510-thread battery designed for use with most vape cartridges. It features 3 voltage settings and one-button operation. The Nutron has been recently updated and now features a USB-C connection for quicker and more efficient charging.

Key Features:
Button Activation
510 Thread
3 Voltage Settings
320mAh Battery
USB-C charging
Superior Calibration
15 Second Preheat
Short Circuit Protection
Overcharge Protection

Included In The Box:
Tronian Nutron Gen 2

Purposefully cable-free. Most clients have a USB-C cable already. No clutter, no waste.
If you need one — we’ve got options.

Please research the product before purchasing. Tronian products are not eligible for returns under any circumstances. Tronian sales are final.

If you have issues with your product, send an email to info@tronian.com and a customer service representative will contact you as early as possible to resolve the issue and find the best solution.
